title: Design System: What I want to say…

developed-display.purpose: Allura heading with one-shot word-mask reveal.

signature.purpose: Large Allura400 signature with a right-side heart.

motion.name: word-reveal
motion.purpose: Stepped mask and opacity; completed runs remove their animation class.

motion.name: paragraph-stagger
motion.purpose: Maximum stagger per paragraph; next paragraph starts on actual completion.

motion.name: paper-arrival
motion.purpose: One entrance, no ongoing paper motion.

motion.name: letter-continuity
motion.purpose: Shared opening-to-letter scene; no third state.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Completed text, immediate stages and static decoration.

components.name: Title opening control
components.description: Only the large title is visible; React owns the opening gesture.
components.css: .ds-title { max-width:9ch; margin:auto; color:#763b54; font:400 clamp(72px,7.5vw,96px)/1.16 'Allura',cursive; letter-spacing:-.015em; text-align:center; text-wrap:balance; } .ds-title button { width:100%; border:0; padding:20px 0; background:transparent; color:inherit; font:inherit; cursor:pointer; text-wrap:balance; } @media(max-width:600px){ .ds-title { font-size:clamp(58px,17.5vw,82px); } }

components.name: Telegram reply
components.description: External HTTPS reply action after the supplied paragraphs.
components.html: Write your answer...
components.css: .ds-reply { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:56px; min-width:246px; padding:17px 25px; border-radius:6px; background:#73394f; color:#fff7ef; font:600 16px 'Figtree',sans-serif; text-decoration:none; } .ds-reply:hover { background:#562538; } .ds-reply:active { background:#431b2b; } @media(max-width:600px){ .ds-reply { min-width:0; width:100%; max-width:286px; padding-inline:18px; } }

components.name: Sender credit
components.description: Centered flowing credit and fingerprint-heart sticker in normal layout.
components.css: .ds-credit { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:12px; width:100%; margin:58px auto 0; color:#975a6e; font:400 clamp(70px,14vw,92px)/1.2 'Allura',cursive; letter-spacing:.01em; } .ds-credit img { width:42px; flex:0 0 42px; height:auto; } @media(max-width:600px){ .ds-credit { gap:10px; } .ds-credit img { width:36px; flex-basis:36px; } }

narrative.northStar: A sincere letter on a rose-toned photographic print
narrative.overview: Rose surroundings and pale real paper carry berry Allura lettering, Alegreya English prose and a single Figtree Telegram reply action. Supplied stickers float at the edges; paragraphs reveal in sequence.
keyCharacteristics: Real photographic paper and supplied stickers.
Flowing lettering paired with readable serif prose.
One optional reply action after a two-state letter.

rules.name: Readable expression
rules.body: Allura carries expression, Alegreya prose, and Figtree controls; keep whole-word shaping during reveals.

rules.name: Material truth
rules.body: Retain scanned fiber/edge assets and their provenance; use the current paper-color blend without stretching the grain.

rules.name: One-shot reading
rules.body: Completed text stops animating; actual paragraph completion advances the sequence.

dos: Anchor mobile stickers near the print.
Keep reply navigation optional and direct.
donts: Do not reintroduce yes/no controls or a third state.
Do not replay completed text or loop paper displacement.
Do not add small opening copy or music controls.
